scope: Native anti-air contact preference for CBE vehicle gunnery; no projectile interception.
intent: Dedicated AA should not prefer every nearby anti-tank rifleman or lose known aircraft behind an eight-ground-contact shortlist. Retain existing knowledge, station, ROE and owner authority.
implementation: CortexKnowledge optional third argument ALL/AIR filters native candidates before the existing eight-contact personal-knowledge evaluation; default callers unchanged. No new revealed or exact hostile position.

CortexVehicles recognises native editorSubcategory EdSubcat_AAs as target preference only. The first eligible firing AA platform obtains one AIR-domain query, shared by other AA platforms in this group callback.
Merge up to eight ordinary rows and eight fresh aircraft rows, deduplicated by known object. Rank fresh aircraft first and inspect at most eight target/station/lane candidates.
Fresh means last native seen/threat age <=3s. Only those AA aircraft candidates use the existing engagement-range setting; other contacts and platforms retain600m and ordinary AT/armour priorities.

Actual loaded turret/muzzle ammunition, fresh command-boundary checks, gunner availability, mission/combined-ground ownership, ROE and firing lanes remain authoritative. No worker, radar/reveal command, missile guidance, synthetic shot or collision effect.
limits: Native AA editor category only: custom mod categories retain ordinary gunnery. This role metadata never proves loaded weapon suitability.
The existing vehicle callback contact prerequisite remains; this is not an independent long-range radar or threat-discovery service.
No ground anti-munition interception, layered allocation, AA displacement or complete Protocol/AEGIS parity.
Additional native knowledge query/personal evaluation is bounded and shared, but aggregate overhead and actual range/aim/firing need physical measurement.

validation.source: baseline plus intended dirty product/test/guide changes, review/handover follow build

loadedStationFollowup.problem: Metadata-only aircraft priority could fill all eight target slots with incompatible aircraft and starve usable ground contacts after merging the separate air shortlist.
loadedStationFollowup.fix: Aircraft preference and extra-row merge now require CortexGroundFireReady against an actual fresh aircraft using the selected actual loaded station. One local station-selection container covers preflight and target selection; a completed failed scan can be reused in the same frame, but final firing always rechecks fresh native ammunition.
loadedStationFollowup.cost: One extra bounded station preflight per eligible AA platform with fresh aircraft, up to32 native state queries. Failed complete scan reuse avoids repeating native queries for ground candidates; successful partial scans are never cached as complete. Aggregate overhead unmeasured.

validation.initialFailure: Existing source-scope assertion expected stationSelection after target declaration; updated to assert unique earlier shared scope. Other snapshot/fresh-fire contracts retained.
